description: Get what's needed to create an inventory item. Without arguments: the organization's category tree plus the required fields that apply to ALL items. With categoryId: the full field list for that category (required and optional, with types and select options). Call this BEFORE create_item: first without arguments to resolve the category with your user, then with the chosen categoryId to learn every required field. In widget-rendering hosts (e.g. ChatGPT) do NOT ask for field values in conversation — call preview_item_create with what you have; its card collects the missing values. Elsewhere, ask for everything in ONE question instead of many. A category is REQUIRED for every item except a draft (isDraft: true). Check that the chosen category actually FITS the item: if none fits, do not force one silently — use the closest one and say so, or save a draft the user finishes in the app. Prefer existing categories; only create a new one (create_category) when the user explicitly asks for it.
